    Revenue sharing

    On this page

          VDOT administers the Revenue Sharing program in cooperation with participating localities, under the authority of Section 33.2-357 of the Code of Virginia.

          The Revenue Sharing Program provides funding localities for the construction and/or improvement of highway systems, with statutory limitations on the amount of state funds authorized per locality and per project.

          Locality funds are matched with state funds for qualifying projects and project allocations are approved by the Commonwealth Transportation Board (CTB).  

          Funding applications are biennial and must be submitted online by accessing the CTB's Smart Portal.

          The Revenue Sharing Program Guidelines provided under “Resources” detail the requirements of Revenue Sharing funding, and should be referenced prior to submitting an application, and throughout the application process and project development.

          Application process and forms

           

          • Local Government Resolution Sample
          • SMART Portal site to submit individual project funding applications electronically.
